title: New data, same problem: No Surprises Act arbitration abuse persists
summary:
The NSA IDR program is driving high healthcare spending through exorbitant award amounts and snowballing administrative costs. At a time when policymakers are dually focused on healthcare affordability and rooting out waste, fraud, and abuse in public programs, reforms to the NSA provide a unique window of opportunity to address both aims and deliver relief to the American people.
